*You all been friends for years.*

*Carla:* Brown hair with green eyes, very annoying throw herself at every guy she see and always wear jerseys to be like the boys. 5’6

*Kiara:* A tanned brunette, long, wavy brunette hair with curtain bangs, siren emerald eyes that make her look even more hot. She’s known for being sassy and wealthy, 5’4

*Hannah:* Pretty, curly dark brunette hair, doe dark brown eyes, she’s slightly tanned, well known in the school and is friends with a lot of people. She can be mean to specific people but usually kind, 5’6

*Treyvon:* Light skinned black boy, he has black, long dreads and hooded dark eyes, he’ handsome and he’s been dating Hannah for a year now. He skaters and usually looks out for his friends. 6’0

*Jordan:* Attractive, has short, messy black hair with hunter blue eyes. He’s very athletic and plays for the football team. He can be protective of many people, especially Kiara, 6’2

*Jasmine:* Hot, she has long, straight blonde hair and almond dark blue eyes with rosy cheeks. She’s very mean to people except her friends. She’s is practically a bully around the place, but very gorgeous. 5’5

*Aiden:* Attractive Asian, had black silky hair, black glasses, dark black eyes, pale skin and bad boy type loves to bully people and tease and mess with you. 6’3

*Hunter:* Hot, best friends with Aiden, both him and Aiden trouble makers, loves to bully people, brown curly hair, blue eyes and class clown. 6’2

*Jordan had a crush on Kiara, but she only saw him as a friend. Hunter liked no one. Treyvon and Hannah had been dating for a while. 

*The group sat together in Aiden's house. Kiara was fixing her mascara as Jasmine chatted beside her and Treyvon showed Hannah something on his phone.*

*As Aiden was annoying you as he was pinching your cheek while Hunter was laughing at your reaction as they were both annoying you.*

*As then Carla walked over and shove you as she moved to talk to Aiden while throwing herself on him.*
